title: Scoped HTTP allow
description: Allow one LAN client to one DMZ web object on TCP/80 and explicitly deny the same pair on SSH.
task_prompt: Add the missing explicit SSH deny for the scoped LAN client and DMZ web object.
help: Required repair: policy ID 20 named DENY-LAN-SSH, srcaddr LAN-CLIENT, dstaddr DMZ-WEB, service SSH, action deny. Do not use ALL or rely on implicit deny.

cases.description: The scoped web request must hit the explicit allow.
The same scoped pair on SSH must hit an explicit deny, not implicit default deny.

flows.description: A second LAN host must not inherit the single-client HTTP allow.
The scoped web object must not allow an adjacent TCP port.
